description: Use this when the signed-in clipper asks to connect their TikTok, Instagram, YouTube or X account, for example "connect my TikTok @rin.clips", so For you ranks campaigns for it. Returns a short bio code like alpha-7KQM and the steps: put the code in the account's bio, then say done, and check_account finds it. The code is good for 24 hours. The same account again returns the same code while it is good, an expired one a fresh code. A different handle for an app whose account still waits for its code replaces that pending one, so connecting the right handle fixes a mistyped one. A connected account is never replaced: the new one is added next to it. Set add_another true only when the clipper wants a second account on the same app next to one still waiting. Up to 10 accounts per ClippingAlpha account. Needs the clipper's ClippingAlpha sign-in. Nothing is posted anywhere and nothing changes on the social account.

add_another.description: True to add this as another account on the same app next to one still waiting for its code, instead of replacing it.

handle.description: The account's handle, as @name, name or its profile link.

platform.description: The social app: tiktok, instagram, youtube or x.

name: connect_account
title: Connect a social account
